howto.what: 装上后，你的聊天系统会获得 WhatsApp 通道，能通过 Meta 官方 API 收发一对一消息。需要手动配置凭证和 Webhook。
howto.when: 当你想让系统支持 WhatsApp 消息，或需要连接 WhatsApp Business 平台时运行此技能。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp Cloud 通道。
设置 WhatsApp Business Cloud API。

howto.what_en: After installation, your chat system gains a WhatsApp channel that can send/receive 1:1 messages via the official Meta API. You must manually configure credentials and webhook.
howto.when_en: Run this skill when you want to enable WhatsApp messaging or connect to the WhatsApp Business platform.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel for me.
Set up WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
Install the WhatsApp adapter and configure it.
